description:

 Selection Navigator Functional Lead (Product Manager)/ defines delivery objectives, prioritizes features, and ensures the design solution that meets customer and business needs. This role partners with global cross\-functional teams in an Agile environment to maximize value and drive continuous improvement.

title: Manager, Product Management
description:
Manages the entire product life cycle for certain product(s) (e.g., hardware, software, wireless, web products, medical devices, etc.) from planning to execution to support the organization's strategy and objectives. Develops and directs marketing programs for a significant product or product category. Compiles and evaluates research on the market's product requirements and identifies enhancements to current features and functionality. Establishes marketing strategies, including product direction, advertising, packaging, pricing, expense budgets, profit plans and future product development, to manage a product or product category's life cycle. Interfaces with engineers, designers, suppliers and customers to develop product requirements and specifications. Prepares and coordinates product introductions and updates.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Electronics Solutions division of Nordson delivers cutting\-edge engineering and applications excellence to the world’s semiconductor, automotive electronics, printed circuit boards and precision assembly manufacturer with innovative fluid dispensing and surface treatment solutions. As part of the Growth and Strategy group for this $250M\+\+ division, the Technical Product Manager (TPM) is responsible for the development, and performance of a product line.
   

  

 The TPM oversee the product’s lifecycle, from conception (working with Market Manager and New Product Development Engineering) to discontinuation. This may include supervising Product Line Specialists who are located in the factory/manufacturing sites where the product is made. The TPM provides leadership within the organization to ensure competitiveness of assigned products and development of strategies to grow revenue profitably.
   

  

**Essential Job Duties And Responsibilities**
* Using the NBS Next Phase Gate process in the development of new products, provide leadership in Phases 0\-2 i.e. \#0 Project Request; \#1 Planning/Feasibility; \#2 Proj Requirements where clear technical and commercial requirements are articulated and documented for NPD Engineering.
* Collaborates with cross\-functional teams in Sales, Operation, Marketing and NPD, to ensure successful product launches and iterations with messaging, marketing collateral, sales tools and aids for sales force.
* Continuously analyze market trends and customer feedback to identify opportunities of growth and improvement for existing products.
* Lead cross\-functional efforts for creating competitive offerings.
* 
* Maintain and communicate internally the competitive landscape of our market/products
+ Build internal knowledge of the competitive landscape by supporting MEKKO updates.
+ Develop and maintain tools/processes to collect the latest competitive information and analyzing data to advise on pricing, strategies, future opportunities, etc.
+ Produces competitive analysis materials comparing product with its key competitors for features and pricing in different geographies
+ Lead quarterly competitive reviews/updates
+ Participates in development of market share assessment and price/performance positioning as needed for existing and new products

* Monitor customer satisfaction and contribute to Operations/Sustaining Continuous Improvement projects, Quality and Cost of Poor Quality programs, etc.
* Leads NBS Next Simplification efforts on product lines to ensure progress towards Leadership Level Performance.
* Other duties may be assigned as required.


**Education And Experience Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree and mechanical or electrical engineering is a plus
* Seven to ten years experience in product or market management role. Demonstrated ability to lead growth initiatives and provide guidance to the company about investment opportunities.
* Possess a highly developed attention to detail with strong organizational and project management skills
* Five years experience people management with proven track record at industrial manufacturing environment
* Thorough and accurate, good analytical skills, problem solver, team oriented individual
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Business acumen and the ability to effectively present the organization and its products
* Establish credibility, rapport, respect, and trust throughout the Division, be viewed as a team player, and work effectively in a dynamic, fast paced environment
* High proficiency with Microsoft Office – Excel, PPT etc.
* Knowledge of SAP a plus


**Preferred Skills And Abilities**
* Experience in a similar role supporting capital equipment for the electronics industry.
* Understanding of electronics manufacturing industry. Knowledge about dispensing industry is a plus.
* Effective matrix style management capabilities.
* Ability to multi\-task and effectively manage daily tasks
* Ability to bring positive change; detail oriented; leading by example
* Resides in India and must be able to travel internationally
* Fluent in English and other Asian languages


**Working Conditions and Physical Demands**
**Office environment.** 
 To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed above are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
   

  

**Travel Required**
 Estimated 45%

title: Senior Product Manager Tech, EU INTech - PGX
description:
**Description**
 Join EU INTech's Partner Growth Experience (PGX) team as a Senior Product Manager Tech and drive innovation in partner\-facing technology solutions across worldwide marketplaces. You'll own strategic product initiatives that directly impact vendor success and Amazon's growth trajectory in the EU region.
   

  

 As a Senior PMT on our team, you'll define product vision and roadmap for tools and experiences that empower thousands of vendors to grow their business on Amazon. You'll work at the intersection of technology, business strategy, and customer obsession, partnering with engineering, UX, and cross\-functional stakeholders across EU and global teams to deliver scalable solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.
   

  

**What Makes This Role Exciting**
 Strategic Impact: Own end\-to\-end product strategy for vendor\-facing tools that influence billions in WW marketplace revenue
   

  

 Innovation at Scale: Build AI\-powered solutions and automation tools that transform how partners interact with Amazon's platform
   

  

 Cross\-functional Leadership: Collaborate with engineering teams, business stakeholders, and regional leaders across multiple EU countries
   

  

 Product\-Driven Culture: Join a growing PMT function within a highly technical organization, helping shape the product management practice
   

  

 Global Reach: Your work will impact vendor experiences across EU marketplaces while contributing to global product standards
   

  

 This role offers the opportunity to drive meaningful change in a fast\-paced, customer\-obsessed environment where your product decisions directly influence partner success and Amazon's competitive position in European retail.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Product Strategy \& Vision
   

  

 Define and own the product roadmap for vendor\-facing tools and experiences, translating business objectives into technical requirements and prioritized feature sets
   

  

 Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and customer discovery to identify opportunities that drive vendor adoption and business growth across EU marketplaces
   

  

 Develop 3\-year product strategies aligned with EU INTech and broader International Stores goals
   

  

 Cross\-Functional Leadership
   

  

 Partner with engineering teams to define technical architecture, make build\-vs\-buy decisions, and ensure scalable solutions that meet current and future needs
   

  

 Collaborate with UX designers to create intuitive, data\-driven experiences that reduce vendor friction and increase engagement
   

  

 Work closely with business stakeholders, retail teams, and regional leaders across EU countries to align product priorities with business outcomes
   

  

 Execution \& Delivery
   

  

 Write detailed product requirements documents (PRDs), user stories, and acceptance criteria that enable engineering teams to build with clarity
   

  

 Drive agile development processes, leading sprint planning, backlog grooming, and release planning to ensure on\-time delivery
   

  

 Make data\-driven trade\-off decisions balancing scope, timeline, and quality while managing stakeholder expectations
   

  

 Metrics \& Impact
   

  

 Define success metrics and KPIs for product initiatives, establishing measurement frameworks to track adoption, engagement, and business impact
   

  

 Analyze product performance data, conduct A/B tests, and iterate based on insights to continuously improve vendor outcomes
   

  

 Report on product health, progress against goals, and ROI to leadership and stakeholders
   

  

 Innovation \& Technical Depth
   

  

 Stay current with emerging technologies (AI/ML, automation, generative AI) and evaluate opportunities to enhance vendor tools and experiences
   

  

 Participate in technical design reviews, providing product perspective on architectural decisions and system integrations
   

  

 Build credibility with engineering teams through technical understanding and ability to engage in detailed technical discussions
   

  

 Stakeholder Management
   

  

 Communicate product vision, strategy, and progress to diverse audiences including executives, engineering leaders, and business partners
   

  

 Manage competing priorities and negotiate trade\-offs across multiple stakeholders with different objectives
   

  

 Build strong relationships across EU and global teams to drive alignment and remove blockers
   

  

**About The Team**
 We deliver comprehensive solutions that facilitate the growth and success of Amazon's partners, both Selling Partners and internal retail teams, across the entire vendor lifecycle.
   

  

 Our team owns a portfolio of 20\+ products spanning six critical areas of the Retail lifecycle: onboarding, listing \& catalog management, availability, business growth, profitability, support \& communication, and business planning \& negotiation.
   

  

 What makes PGX unique is our EU\-centric yet global approach. We leverage our proximity to Europe's sophisticated retail environment to build solutions that start regionally but scale worldwide. We collaborate extensively with global and regional tech teams, employing a strategic divide\-and\-conquer approach that accelerates innovation while avoiding duplication.
   

  

 Our culture is built on five core tenets: We're EU\-centric yet global in our solutions. We put customers first, prioritizing end customers, then selling partners, then Amazon. We embrace continuous learning, staying stubborn on vision but flexible on details. We champion standardization through reusable software architecture. And we believe less is more, building simple, intuitive experiences over complex one\-size\-fits\-all solutions.
   

  

 The team operates in a highly collaborative, fast\-paced environment where product managers work closely with engineering, UX, science, and business stakeholders across multiple countries and time zones. You'll partner with central platform teams, regional retail organizations, and global tech leaders to shape product strategy that directly impacts billions in revenue and millions of customer experiences.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to join a team that's redefining Selling Partner experience at Amazon scale, working on products that matter to vendors worldwide while being part of a culture that values innovation, customer obsession, and technical excellence.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive\-level prioritization and planning


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
* Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
   

  

  

**Company** 
 \- ADCI \- Karnataka

title: Product Manager, Google Photos
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end\-to\-end, 0 to 1, etc.).
* Experience integrating generative AI tools or Large Language Model (LLM) interfaces into workflows.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Master's degree in a technology or business related field.
* 3 years of experience in a role preparing and delivering technical presentations to executive leadership.
* Experience working on consumer\-facing UI products that operate at scale, with a strong emphasis on mobile app experiences (iOS/Android).
* Experience working with GenAI and ML technologies and how they can be applied to creative user problems.
* Experience using data and analytics to drive product growth and optimize user engagement metrics.
* Ability to work effectively in a complex organizational setup, collaborating with teams across different time zones and geographies.


**About The Job**
 At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
   

  

 In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.
   

  

 One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.
   

  

 Hundreds of millions of users consume Memories to look back at their photos library, to ground themselves in what matters most to them.
   

  

 While the underlying human need around identity and have not changed, AI is unleashing a set of capabilities that lets us deliver on these needs better than ever before, and in a more personalized way than ever before.
   

  

 In this role, your role is to capture this opportunity to deliver the next generation of the Memories experience. You will build a system that understands what's in each user's library and the context of what's going on in their life, and adapts to deliver the right moments at the right time, in formats that are fresh and engaging for that user.
   

  

 Google Photos is a photo sharing and storage service developed by Google. Photos is one of the most sought after products at Google and is looking for both client\-side (web and mobile), with server\-side (search, storage, serving) and machine intelligence (learning, computer vision) Software Engineers. We are dedicated to making Google experiences centered around the user.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Work with partner teams (e.g., Engineers, Program Managers (PgMs), UX) during product design and development to implement the requirements to turn PRDs into OKRs for one or more teams. Drive launches, maintenance, and retirement in collaboration with other cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Set the vision, goals, strategy, and roadmap for your workstreams, and align cross\-functional and cross\-product area stakeholders.
* Partner with UX Researcher (UXR) to drive user research to surface insights and validate product concepts, and with UX to design delightful experiences. Develop clear and thorough product requirements to drive engineering designs.
* Execute your roadmap with engineering and cross\-functional/cross\-product teams to build, test, launch, and land product features to achieve your goals.
* Define and track key metrics, analyze market and product data, and utilize experimentation to make data\-driven decisions toward your goal.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

 We're hiring

title: Sr, Product Manager II - Gantt View (Hybrid, Bangalore)

 We are seeking a seasoned and strategic Senior Product Manager II to join our Product Organization. title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Location:** 
 India
   

  

**Function:** 
 Product Management
   

  

**Reports To:** 
 Sr. Director, Cloud Platform
   

  

**Are you...**
* Interested in shaping shared cloud platform services that power multiple products and engineering teams?
* Passionate about platform product management, developer experience, and turning complex technical capabilities into valuable products?
* Excited to work alongside Architects and Engineering leaders to shape the evolution of a modern cloud and AI platform?


 If so, we'd love to meet you.
   

  

**Why Esko?**
 Esko, part of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), is the global leader in packaging and product lifecycle solutions. More than 25,000 customers across 140\+ countries rely on Esko to design, manage, manufacture, and deliver products found on store shelves every day. Packaging for 9 out of 10 major consumer brands is managed using Esko solutions. As we enter our next phase of growth, we're making significant investments in cloud, AI, and platform engineering to build the future of product innovation.
   

  

 Our vision is to create the industry's leading AI\-native Product Intelligence Platform. This modern, multi\-tenant cloud platform unifies product, packaging, regulatory, quality, manufacturing, and supply chain data into a single intelligent ecosystem. By combining cloud\-native architecture, intelligent automation, and AI\-powered insights, we're helping global consumer goods, life sciences, and manufacturing companies innovate faster, improve compliance, reduce waste, and bring products to market with greater speed and confidence.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a
 **Senior Product Manager – Cloud Platform Services** 
 to define and drive the product strategy for the cloud platform services that power Esko's SaaS products.
   

  

 You will own the product direction and roadmap for foundational capabilities such as repository and data services, workflow, search, APIs, and other shared platform services used across multiple Esko products. You will work closely with Architects, Engineering leaders, and Product Managers to identify common platform needs, establish priorities, drive adoption, and translate platform strategy into an executable roadmap.
   

  

 You must be comfortable engaging with Architects and Engineering leaders on APIs, distributed systems, data architectures, cloud\-native services, scalability, reliability, and technical trade\-offs.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Define and drive the product strategy, roadmap, and priorities for Cloud Platform Services.
* Own the product direction for shared capabilities such as repository and data services, workflow, search, APIs, and other foundational platform services.
* Partner with product and engineering teams to identify common needs and opportunities for reusable platform capabilities.
* Partner with Architects and Engineering leaders on platform architecture and technical direction, bringing product context to technical decisions and trade\-offs.
* Drive a strong developer experience, making platform capabilities easier to discover, integrate, and adopt.
* Lead cross\-platform planning and align dependencies across Platform Services, IAM, Infrastructure Engineering, and consuming product teams.
* Balance product needs, platform investments, technical debt, reliability, scalability, and architectural evolution when setting priorities.
* Define success measures and use adoption, usage, developer experience, reliability, and business outcomes to guide platform investments.


**Required Experience**
* 10\+ years of experience in the software industry, including 5\+ years in product management for cloud, SaaS, API, developer, or other technically complex software products.
* Experience owning the strategy and roadmap for platform products or shared services used by multiple products or engineering teams.
* Strong technical understanding of APIs, microservices, distributed systems, data stores, multi\-tenancy, and cloud\-native architectures.
* Demonstrated ability to participate effectively in architecture and technical design discussions with Architects and senior Engineers, understand trade\-offs, and connect technical decisions to product outcomes.

description:
**Role:** 
 Product Manager \- AI Services
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bangalore (Quarterly visit for 2 weeks)

 Product Management
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 Director, Packaging Intelligence
   

  

**Are you...**
* Passionate about architecting large\-scale cloud platforms?
* Excited to define technology that powers an entire portfolio of products, not just a single application?
* Interested in building the industry's leading AI\-native Product Intelligence Platform?


 If so, we'd love to meet you.
   

  

**Why Esko?**
 Esko, part of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), is the global leader in packaging and product lifecycle solutions. More than 25,000 customers across 140\+ countries rely on Esko to design, manage, manufacture, and deliver products found on store shelves every day. Packaging for 9 out of 10 major consumer brands is managed using Esko solutions. As we enter our next phase of growth, we're making significant investments in cloud, AI, and platform engineering to build the future of product innovation.
   

  

 Our vision is to create the industry's leading AI\-native Product Intelligence Platform. This modern, multi\-tenant cloud platform unifies product, packaging, regulatory, quality, manufacturing, and supply chain data into a single intelligent ecosystem. By combining cloud\-native architecture, intelligent automation, and AI\-powered insights, we're helping global consumer goods, life sciences, and manufacturing companies innovate faster, improve compliance, reduce waste, and bring products to market with greater speed and confidence.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As Product Manager for AI Services, you will own the product lifecycle for a shared foundation of AI capabilities that Esko's internal teams build on rather than re\-invent \- enabling them to solve customer problems that were previously out of reach with optimal speed and efficiency.
   

  

 Cross\-functional collaboration sits at the core of the role. You will coach internal teams, consolidate their needs to find common ground, work with technical and design stakeholders to agree the best approach, and document clear, testable requirements that are reviewed and approved before development begins. The result is a coherent, prioritized backlog and roadmap that reflects the combined needs of Esko's product teams and aligns with company strategy and AI transformation objectives.
   

  

 You will keep stakeholders updated as work progresses, then support them through acceptance testing, triage and implement change requests, and drive adoption of the services in production. Ongoing success management is central: keeping services aligned with evolving team and customer needs while maintaining a generalized approach and backwards compatibility, and growing capabilities in line with advances in technology and market expectations. You will track adoption and key performance metrics to demonstrate impact and identify where more focus is needed.
   

  

 As a key member of the Esko AI team, you will also help shape the strategic vision for Esko's AI initiatives through brainstorming, thought leadership, customer discussions and events.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Own and prioritize the product backlog for AI Services – a shared collection of common AI capabilities leveraged by Esko product and engineering teams.
* Proactively gather needs from cross\-functional product teams and turn them into clear, well\-scoped requirements for the Esko AI engineering teams.
* Act as a bridge between Esko AI and other cross\-functional teams \- product, engineering, and commercial – to ensure their success in building AI\-powered capabilities that deliver on the intended customer value.
* Help other teams to bootstrap their own AI initiatives on top of the shared capabilities: clarifying what already exists, what needs to be built, and how to get started.
* Weigh competing requests from multiple stakeholders against the long\-term company strategy and priorities, while documenting risks and expected trade\-offs.
* Define and maintain adoption / success metrics for the shared capabilities \- and use them to continually re\-prioritize the backlog and indicate risks and areas of additional focus.
* Communicate roadmap, priorities, and trade\-offs clearly across engineering, product, and leadership stakeholders.


**What We Are Looking For**
* At least 5 years’ experience in a Software Product Management role, preferably including ownership of a platform, API or other shared\-services product used across multiple internal teams.
* Undergraduate or master’s degree in computer science or related discipline.
* Native or fluent proficiency in English.
* Experience initiating, deploying, and scaling AI\-powered capabilities in production, with a track record of managing the development cycle from proof\-of\-concepts or early\-stage ideas into production capabilities that other teams depend on.
* Experience acting as a liaison in a large, global organization with multiple cross\-functional teams \- gathering and distilling requirements from varied stakeholders, aligning competing priorities, and driving toward a successful shared outcome.
* Strong product management fundamentals: backlog ownership and refinement, roadmap creation \& communication, and the ability to write clear, unambiguous requirements for engineering to build and test against.
* Comfort operating at the boundary between a platform team and the product teams that consume it, balancing shared needs and central objectives against individual team priorities and timelines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to work fluently with both technical and business stakeholders alike.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience in packaging graphics or the wider graphic arts industry is strongly preferred.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Teams across the business ship AI\-powered capabilities that solve valuable customer problems by leveraging a shared foundation of AI Services, rather than “re\-inventing the wheel”.
* Ideas and concepts forged by different teams are assessed for potential development as centralized AI services.
* A roadmap for AI Services is maintained and accurately describes the status of current and plans for future objectives.
* The Esko AI engineering teams work from a clearly prioritized backlog.
* Cross\-functional teams know exactly who to talk to when they want to bootstrap an AI initiative; and that person offers guidance on opportunities, prioritization and planning.
* AI services are clearly explained and documented, with measures taken to minimize any roadblocks or barriers to successful adoption.
* AI Services grows as a coherent whole rather than fragmenting into one\-off, team\-specific solutions.
* A class\-leading set of capabilities provide a powerful base for Esko cross\-functional teams to transform the value of our software using cutting\-edge AI technologies.

We’re backed by Peak XV Partners, Elevation, Fundamentum, and other top\-tier investors, and are one of India’s fastest\-growing Series C consumer\-tech companies.
 



 Our flagship product, Sri Mandir, is the world’s largest platform for Hindu devotees, powering rituals, teachings, personalized recommendations, and a thriving devotional community. India’s $44B devotion economy is still largely offline, and we’re bringing structure, accessibility, and meaning to this massive market, where design and data play a central role in shaping user behavior at scale.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We’re looking for a Retention Manager – Product Growth to own one of our most important growth problems: how do we get users to come back, transact more frequently, and build a long\-term relationship with Sri Mandir?
 



 This role sits at the intersection of Product, Growth, CRM and Data. You will use user behaviour, cohort insights and experimentation to identify retention opportunities and turn them into scalable product, engagement and lifecycle interventions.
 



 This is not a traditional CRM/campaign role. You will own the retention problem, while working with Product, CRM, Data, Design and Business teams to determine the right levers to solve it.
 



  





**What You Will Own** 



* **Retention Strategy:** 
 Build and drive the retention roadmap across new, repeat, dormant and high\-value user cohorts.

 Deep\-dive into user behaviour, cohorts, frequency, repeat patterns and LTV to identify the biggest retention opportunities.
* **Product\-led Retention:** 
 Design and scale interventions such as subscriptions, loyalty/reward systems, personalisation, pricing/discounting and repeat\-use experiences.
* **Experimentation:** 
 Build a continuous experimentation pipeline — identify hypotheses, define success metrics, launch experiments and measure incremental impact.
* **Reactivation \& Frequency:** 
 Identify opportunities to bring dormant users back and increase the frequency of existing users through product and engagement interventions.
* **Cross\-functional Execution:** 
 Partner closely with Product, CRM, Data, Design and Business teams to take retention initiatives from insight → PRD/experiment → launch → measurement → scale.
* **Retention Measurement:** 
 Build frameworks to understand the impact of retention initiatives on repeat rate, frequency, revenue, contribution margin and LTV.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Diagnose Retention Problems** 



* Analyse retention and repeat behaviour across user, category, product, deity, geography, platform, acquisition source and other relevant dimensions.
* Identify where and why users drop off across their lifecycle.
* Translate data into clear behavioural insights and actionable opportunities.



**2\. Build Retention Solutions** 



* Convert insights into product, loyalty, personalisation and lifecycle hypotheses.
* Work with Product and CRM teams to design solutions that address specific user needs and behavioural gaps.
* Prioritise opportunities based on expected user and business impact.



**3\. Run a Strong Experimentation Engine** 



* Own the retention experimentation roadmap.
* Define hypotheses, control/treatment groups, success metrics and measurement frameworks.
* Evaluate experiments based on
 **incremental impact** 
 , not just engagement metrics.
* Scale successful interventions and quickly learn from unsuccessful ones.



**4\. Improve Repeat \& Lifetime Value** 



* Develop strategies to increase repeat transactions and user frequency.
* Identify opportunities to move users from first transaction → repeat → high\-frequency behaviour.
* Build interventions that improve long\-term user value rather than short\-term conversion alone.



**5\. Build Retention Intelligence** 



* Develop and maintain retention dashboards and reporting frameworks for daily/weekly decision\-making.
* Track key metrics including retention, repeat rate, frequency, reactivation and LTV.
* Establish clear measurement frameworks for major retention initiatives.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* **6–8 years of experience** 
 in growth, retention, product growth, lifecycle, consumer internet or related roles.
* Strong experience solving
 **consumer retention and engagement problems** 
 through data and experimentation.
* Strong analytical ability with hands\-on experience in
 **cohort analysis, funnel analysis, retention metrics and LTV/business impact analysis** 
 .
* Strong product sense — able to identify user problems and translate them into product or growth opportunities.
* Experience running
 **A/B tests and growth experiments** 
 end\-to\-end.
* Understanding of CRM/lifecycle marketing and how communication can complement product\-led retention.
* Comfortable working with
 **SQL, product analytics and dashboards** 
 such as Mixpanel, Metabase, Superset or equivalent tools.
* Strong cross\-functional skills — able to work effectively with Product, Data, Design, CRM and Business teams.
* Bias towards action, experimentation and measurable outcomes.
* Ability to operate in ambiguity and independently identify and solve high\-impact problems.



  





**What Will Make You Successful** 




 You should naturally think in a loop:
 



**Understand user behaviour → Identify the retention problem → Form a hypothesis → Build the right intervention → Experiment → Measure incremental impact → Scale** 




 You should be equally comfortable discussing:
 


* Why a user did not return
* What behavioural segment is most valuable
* What product change could improve repeat behaviour
* Whether a subscription/loyalty intervention will actually create incremental retention
* How CRM can amplify a product intervention
* Whether an experiment genuinely moved LTV or simply shifted existing demand



  





**Key Deliverables** 



* **Retention Opportunity Roadmap** 
 across new, repeat, dormant and high\-value cohorts
* **Retention \& Cohort Intelligence Dashboard** 
 for ongoing decision\-making
* Continuous
 **Retention Experimentation Pipeline** 
 with clear hypotheses and measurement
* Successful rollout and optimisation of
 **product\-led retention initiatives**
* Measurable improvement in
 **repeat rate, retention, frequency, reactivation and LTV**
* Clear post\-launch measurement and learning framework for all major retention initiatives



  





**Why This Role Matters** 




 Sri Mandir serves users across very different spiritual needs, behaviours and frequencies. The next phase of growth is not only about acquiring more users — it is about
 **understanding what brings users back and building experiences that make the next spiritual action easier, more relevant and more meaningful.** 




 This role will be at the centre of that problem —
 **building the systems, insights and experiments that turn one\-time users into long\-term users.** 




  





**One Team. One Goal. Assisting millions on their digital devotional journeys**

title: Product Owner
description:
**Job Description**
 As a Product Owner, you are responsible for maximizing the value of the product and the work of the Delivery Team by clearly expressing Product Backlog items. You are responsible for ordering the items to best achieve goals and missions. You will calculate, measure and track business value, as well as optimize the value of the work the Development Team performs ensuring that the Product Backlog is visible, transparent, and clear to all. This will show what the Delivery Team will work on next. You will ensure the Delivery Team understands items in the Product Backlog to the level needed.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and explicitly communicate the Product Goal
* Manage and maintain a transparent product backlog, re\-evaluate customer product needs and continually balance priorities of the product across maintenance and strategic initiatives
* Review product features as they are developed, providing feedback and guidance.
* Participate as a member of the Agile Team, attend Scrum Events, and is responsible for defining epics and stories including Acceptance Criteria and Definition of Done
* Interacts with a diverse set of stakeholders, including Senior Management, business and technology teams, customers, suppliers, and external partners
* Represent the needs of many stakeholders in the Product Backlog and work directly with delivery teams as the voice of the customer
* Drive cohesion across the team but focus efforts on the desired features, while ensuring that each team member is able to contribute to the product’s goals
* Provide clear direction and flexibility when priorities change based on user needs and requirements
* Participate in Agile SDLC activities, including planning, refinement, stand\-ups and retrospectives. Provide support to manage iteration planning and refinement of user stories. Spotlight inter\-dependencies among cross\-product development teams to ensure seamless delivery
* Collaborate with other POs, and Product Executives to ensure the vision of the product is being met and that the product backlog is aligned with the program backlog
* Coordinate closely with the Product Executive to ensure alignment with the Outcome Based Product Roadmap and Objectives and Key Results (OKRs)
* Serve as a thought leader for a specific business and technology team and assists other leaders with the delegation of work assignments
* Embody the Scrum Values: Openness, Respect, Courage, Commitment and Focus
* Be “The Ideal Team Member” – Hungry, Humble, and Smart.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or related field, or equivalent, relevant work experience required.
* 6 or more years’ experience as a Product Owner with Agile facilitation background, working in an agile environment (e.g. user stories, iterative development, scrum teams, sprints, personas)
* Ability to write clear precise Scrum user stories for scrum teams
* Must have a bias for action and be comfortable in an ever changing or ambiguous environment
* Strong knowledge of Agile frameworks such as SAFe or Scrum@Scale
* Product Innovation, Design thinking and/or CX/UX experience is a plus

* Familiarity in working in a SaaS environment

title: Senior Product Manager, Growth (Based in Dubai)
description:
**DUBAI BASED ROLE.** 
 Relocation would be required but with highly competitive, tax free salary package.
 



  





**Company Profile:** 




  





 Property Finder is the leading property portal in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region, dedicated to shaping an inclusive future for real estate while spearheading the region’s growing tech ecosystem. At its core is a clear and powerful purpose: To change living for good in the region.
 



 Founded on the value of great ambitions, Property Finder connects millions of property seekers with thousands of real estate professionals every day. The platform offers a seamless and enriching experience, empowering both buyers and renters to make informed decisions. Since its inception in 2007, Property Finder has evolved into a trusted partner for developers, brokers, and home seekers. As a lighthouse tech company, it continues to create an environment where people can thrive and contribute meaningfully to the transformation of real estate in MENA.
 



  





**Role Summary:** 




  





 Property Finder is the leading property portal in the UAE and MENA, and one of the most visited Real Estate destinations in the region. Millions of people use it every month to find a home, and most of them arrive because the product itself brought them there.
 



 We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead our product\-led growth work: making the product easier to discover, faster to get value from, more rewarding to come back to, and something people want to share. You will lead a cross\-functional squad, own the roadmap, and be accountable for the results.
 



 This is a senior, hands\-on role for a rare kind of generalist: someone with a quantitative mind, real depth across product, SEO, performance marketing, research, data and engineering, and the taste and presence to carry a growth story from a spreadsheet to the executive room.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  




* Own and lead the product\-led growth roadmap, from discovery to delivery to results.
* Grow the product's organic reach: the pages, tools and content surfaces that make Property Finder the place people land when they search for anything to do with property, including through AI assistants.
* Make the product shareable and viral. Build the moments people want to send to a partner, a friend or a colleague, and make sharing effortless.
* Design first sessions that get new visitors to value quickly, and experiences that bring people back throughout their property journey.
* Bring engagement and gamification into the product with taste: recognition, progress and reward that feel natural in a high\-stakes decision like finding a home.
* Turn user contributions into product: reviews, questions, opinions and local knowledge that make the product richer for everyone.
* Run a disciplined experimentation programme: hypotheses, guardrails, clean reads and honest write\-ups when a test loses.
* Work hand in hand with performance marketing so paid and organic reinforce each other rather than compete.
* Use AI as a working method, not a slide: research, analysis, prototyping, content and data workflows.
* Lead the squad day to day: prioritisation, specs, experiments, readouts and shipped work.
* Work closely with SEO, Data Science, Engineering, Design, Analytics and Marketing, and keep growth on the consumer side aligned with the business.
* Communicate crisply with senior stakeholders and represent the growth story across the company.



  





**Desired Experience:** 




  




* You have built products that grew on their own having spread through its own users and search, and you can explain what worked, what did not, and why.
* Eight or more years in product, most of it on consumer products at scale, with at least three in a growth role where you owned the number.
* Quantitative by training. A degree in mathematics, physics, engineering, computer science or a similar discipline, ideally with an MBA or comparable business education on top.
* First principles reasoning and you are comfortable with models.
* End to end knowledge. Discovery, user research, specs, prioritisation, experimentation and readouts.
* You have designed and read A/B tests properly, including the messy ones with lag, seasonality and interference, and you know when not to trust a result.
* Hands\-on with SEO. Technical, content and off\-page.
* You have worked in Search Console and crawl data yourself, shipped templated pages at scale, and understand how search engines and AI assistants source and cite answers.
* Deep understanding of performance marketing. Paid search, paid social and app campaigns: how they are bought, measured and attributed, and how they interact with organic.
* User research. Interviews, surveys, usability sessions and behavioural analysis, and you know which one answers which question.
* Strong with data. SQL and product analytics as a daily habit, statistics you can apply rather than recite, and dashboards you built yourself.
* You can code and you speak engineering. Python or JavaScript well enough to pull data, prototype a feature or automate a workflow, and enough architecture to have a real conversation about trade\-offs and effort. Engineers trust your judgement.
* AI skills. You use LLMs and agents as a working method for research, analysis, prototyping and content, you have built or orchestrated agentic workflows, and you have a grounded view of where they help and where they hurt.
* You can take a complex story to an executive room, hold attention, answer the hard question and leave with a decision.



  





**Nice to have:** 




  




* Marketplace experience where you have worked on a two\-sided product and know that growth on one side has consequences on the other.
* Real Estate, classifieds or marketplace background in the UAE or GCC.
* Experience with user\-generated content, loyalty or gamification products, or App Store Optimisation.
* Arabic language skills



  





**Why this role?** 




  




* Scale and stakes: millions of monthly users, the leading position in the market, and a mandate to extend it.
* Real ownership: a squad, a roadmap and a budget conversation that are yours to shape.
* A team that treats growth as a product discipline, not a marketing tactic, and works with data science and engineering as peers.
* Direct exposure to the executive team, and a manager who expects you to disagree with him when the evidence says so.

title: Engineering Manager - Nonlinear Productivity (Friction Elimination & Solutions)
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
   

  

 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high\-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co\-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
   

  

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025\. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.


**An Overview Of This Role**
 As Manager, Engineering, Nonlinear Productivity (Friction Elimination \& Solutions), you’ll help GitLab break the linear relationship between headcount and engineering output. In this role, you’ll oversee the initiative’s forward\-scanning work, reviewing GitLab’s software development lifecycle and code\-generation workflows to spot recurring friction, test durable fixes, and identify internal solutions that could become customer\-facing products.
   

  

 You’ll report to the Senior Manager or Director, Nonlinear Productivity and work at the intersection of engineering, developer productivity, AI\-assisted development, and product. You’ll build a data\-backed view of where technical interventions can have the highest leverage, test solutions through prototypes, drive validated fixes into internal adoption, and help build the case for productizing the strongest outcomes.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Survey GitLab’s internal software development lifecycle and code\-generation workflows to identify structural friction early, and build a data\-backed view of where technical interventions will have the highest leverage.
* Evaluate build, buy, and adapt options for each opportunity, including emerging agentic and AI tooling, with a clear view of cost, risk, and durability.
* Stand up prototypes and review architecture directly to test whether a proposed fix moves a target metric and represents a durable solution before GitLab makes broader engineering investment.
* Hire and manage a small, high\-caliber team, or operate as a hands\-on working manager, with a focus on talent density over headcount.
* Drive validated fixes from prototype to internal adoption by partnering with affected teams so solutions are relied on, used, and maintained.
* Build the technical and business case for productizing internal fixes that prove durable, in partnership with product.
* Document reusable learnings so successful internal fixes don’t remain tribal knowledge.
* Report impact through changes in key metrics and progress on turning internal fixes into products, including a clear account of what didn’t work.


**What You’ll Bring**
* Ability to use GitLab.
* A track record of identifying and shipping technical fixes for developer productivity, continuous integration and continuous delivery, or platform friction, including problems you found before they were assigned.
* Comfort operating with high ambiguity and no existing backlog, building the roadmap rather than executing one handed down.
* People management experience, including in a small\-team or working\-manager capacity.
* Technical depth to evaluate and prototype solutions directly, not only direct others toward them.
* Product judgment to assess whether an internal tool could hold up for paying customers.
* Familiarity with agentic or AI\-assisted development tooling.
* Experience moving an internal tool toward an external, customer\-facing product is advantageous.


**About The Team**
 The Nonlinear Productivity team improves how GitLab engineers, and increasingly agents, build, review, and ship code. We test and scale durable technical fixes that improve our internal engineering output.
   

  

**Career ladder**
 In this role, you can progress to Senior Manager, Nonlinear Productivity, with an expanded mandate across the full set of team metrics we use to track improvement.
   

  

 Additional details about our process can be found on our hiring page.
   

  

**How GitLab Supports Full\-Time Employees**
* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well\-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation \& Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave


 Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. title: Senior Marketplace Strategic Account Manager
description:

 Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here.
   

  

 The
 **Senior Strategic Account Manager**

 Marketplace selling Partners with a focus on growth, profitability, and market share expansion. This role blends

title: Senior Engineering Manager, Consumer
description:
**About Ethos**
 Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three\-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As the engineering leader on our Consumer team, you will oversee teams responsible for the direct to consumer user experience. In this role, you will work closely with Product, Design, User Research, and other stakeholders to build fullstack features that educate and support users through the pre\-application, application, package select, and checkout funnels. You will lead, strategize, develop and execute projects to optimize conversion rates through AB tests. You will collaborate with our Underwriting, Enterprise Sales, and Data engineering teams to support the entire user and event lifecycle and data model. You will work with Senior Engineers to decompose an existing monolithic application into scalable micro services.
   

  

 The Consumer team is responsible for the customer journey and is the largest revenue driver across the company. You will be joining at a critical time to drive outsized impact, define organizational strategy and shape team culture.
   

  

**Duties And Responsibilities**
* Lead high\-impact tech and product initiatives in order to accelerate our business growth.
* Work closely with product, design, content and marketing to ideate and experiment with new product strategies.
* Use quantitative and qualitative insights to make data\-informed decisions.
* Obsess over your pod's core metrics and KPIs.
* Uphold a strong bar for engineering velocity, delivery and execution.
* Review design, architecture and help mentor the team.
* Recruit, hire, grow, and retain A\+ engineering talent.
* Provide meaningful feedback to your team to enable their work and growth.


**Qualifications And Skills**
* 3\+ years of engineering management experience in high\-growth engineering organizations
* 5\+ years of engineering experience as an individual contributor
* Experience building large, business critical projects which are highly cross functional in nature and require a deep understanding of business logic
* Demonstrated ability to work closely with product to craft a strategy for new business opportunities
* Ability to own consumer\-focused metrics like ARPU, conversion, retention, and churn.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, adept at working in a cross\-functional group.
* Be a self\-starter, you are able to get things going without much guidance.
* Experience implementing process best practices within a rapidly growing team.
* Know how to build focused roadmaps and make difficult trade\-offs.


 Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At Ethos we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the SF Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment for qualified applicants with arrests and conviction records.
   

  

 To learn more about what information we collect and how it may be used, please refer to our California Candidate Privacy Notice.
   

  

***Recruitment Notice: Please be aware of recruitment scams. All legitimate communication from our team will only come from email addresses ending in @ethos.com or @getethos.com.***
***We will never ask for payment, banking details, or sensitive personal information during the hiring process. If you are contacted by someone claiming to represent us from a different email address, please treat it as fraudulent.***

title: Retail Vendor Manager II
description:
**Description**
 Amazon.com strives to be Earth's most customer\-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. The Category Manager will work on offering dedicated support to top\-tiered brands to grow with Amazon by identifying and improving key customer inputs for growth such as content, marketing and stock availability among others. Apart from this, the Category Manager will also help brands leverage Amazon’s tools and programs to improve on their business inputs.
   

  

 We are seeking creative, goal\-oriented and highly entrepreneurial people to join our exciting and fast\-paced team.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Category Managers at Amazon have end to end responsibility of the customer experience and growth of their category. Amazon strives to present its customers with the widest selection of products at the best prices. Category managers anticipate their customer needs and incorporate them into the business roadmap and own end\-to\-end execution with stakeholders including brands and sellers. They will also drive major changes or enhancement for customer experience influencing category needs based on their knowledge of competitive trends in the marketplace and other macro environment data.
   

  

 Responsibilities Include
   

  

 The successful candidate will be the business owner, with responsibility for signing the right mix of selection in partnership with sellers, adding unique selection, driving traffic conversion, relevant promotion constructs while delivering top notch customer experience on catalog as well. She/he must be an effective leader and communicator working with our most important partners, as well as with internal colleagues and groups. She/he will have strong business judgment with a track record of strong ownership values and relationship management skills. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work on a new business challenge.
   

  

 As a Category Manager in Shoes, you will focus on delivering a world\-class customer experience and exceptional sales and margin growth for the sub\-categories that you are responsible for as we rapidly expand and grow our selection from around the world.
   

  

 The person who joins this team in this position must share our passion and commitment for serving our customers. This ideal candidate should have experience in forging and building stakeholder relationships. Some understanding of planning product cycles and selling online is preferred. The right candidate will be flexible, action and results oriented, self\-starting and have strong analytical skills. He or she must have a proven track record in taking ownership, driving results and moving with speed to implement ideas in a fast\-paced environment. He should be entrepreneurial with the confidence to make independent, data\-driven decisions.
   

  

**The Candidate Must Demonstrate The Ability To Succeed At**
 Defining and implementing strategies
   

  

 Driving an online business
   

  

 Managing internal and external stakeholders
   

  

 Planning and forecasting
   

  

 He or she must be able to develop clear thinking and business rationale for new features \& services to bring customers ease\-of\-use and innovation with a razor sharp focus on solving for the customer while driving operational excellence in execution. The candidate must be an effective communicator in working with some of Amazon’s most important partners and vendors, as well as with internal colleagues and groups. The candidate must have a desire to participate in change and appreciate a dynamic environment with rapidly changing priorities. We are seeking someone with demonstrated history of successful project ownership using customer data to identify and prioritize opportunities.
   

  

 Candidate will own one of the critical businesses for Footwear business responsible for success of both immediate as well as long term strategy.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of with Excel experience
* 5\+ years of retail, operations, product or program management, or business management/consulting with negotiations and delivering results experience
* Experience with financial analysis and P\&L ownership


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience managing large data sets and utilizing to drive performance and process improvements
* Experience in vendor negotiations, pricing and promotion, inventory management, and product development

If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. As a global leader in robotic\-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.
   

  

 We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.
   

  

 The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.
   

  

 If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you’ll find your purpose here.
   

  

**Job Description**

 The Sr Business System Analyst will act as Workday Systems Analyst/Developer and possess both the functional \& technical understanding of Workday HCM and will serve as primary source for Tier 2/Tier 3 technical support, configuration, and development of interfaces and functional enhancements.

title: Assurance - Financial Market - Kyriba – Senior Associate
description:
At PwC, our people in finance consulting specialise in providing consulting services related to financial management and strategy. These individuals analyse client needs, develop financial solutions, and offer guidance and support to help clients optimise their financial performance, improve decision\-making, and achieve their financial goals.
   

  

 As a finance consulting generalist at PwC, you will possess a broad understanding of various aspects of finance consulting. Your work will involve providing comprehensive guidance and support to clients in optimising their financial performance, improving decision\-making, and achieving their financial goals. You will be responsible for analysing client needs, developing financial solutions, and offering recommendations tailored to specific business requirements.
   

  

 Focused on relationships, you are building meaningful client connections, and learning how to manage and inspire others. Navigating increasingly complex situations, you are growing your personal brand, deepening technical expertise and awareness of your strengths. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, and to deliver quality. Embracing increased ambiguity, you are comfortable when the path forward isn’t clear, you ask questions, and you use these moments as opportunities to grow.
   

  

**Skills**
 Examples of the skills, knowledge, and experiences you need to lead and deliver value at this level include but are not limited to:
   

  

* Respond effectively to the diverse perspectives, needs, and feelings of others.
* Use a broad range of tools, methodologies and techniques to generate new ideas and solve problems.
* Use critical thinking to break down complex concepts.
* Understand the broader objectives of your project or role and how your work fits into the overall strategy.
* Develop a deeper understanding of the business context and how it is changing.
* Use reflection to develop self awareness, enhance strengths and address development areas.
* Interpret data to inform insights and recommendations.
* Uphold and reinforce professional and technical standards (e.g. refer to specific PwC tax and audit guidance), the Firm's code of conduct, and independence requirements.


**Responsibilities**
 As a Senior Associate, you'll work as part of a team of problem solvers, helping to solve complex business issues. PwC Professional skills and responsibilities for this management level include but are not limited to:
   

  

* Lead or support Kyriba implementation projects from initiation to go\-live, ensuring timely and successful delivery.
* Gather and analyze business requirements related to cash management, payments, debt, investments, and risk.
* Configure Kyriba modules to support client business processes including Cash \& Liquidity, Payments, Forecasting, Accounting, Bank Connectivity, and Risk Management.
* Coordinate with client stakeholders, banks, and Kyriba support for integrations and testing.
* Design and deliver training sessions and user documentation for client teams.
* Conduct UAT (User Acceptance Testing) and assist in change management processes.
* Provide post\-go\-live support, troubleshoot issues, and offer continuous improvement recommendations.
* Act as a subject matter expert on best practices in treasury operations and Kyriba system capabilities.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including finance, IT, and third\-party vendors.
* Demonstrating extensive abilities and/or a proven record of success as a team member in a professional services consulting firm, including, but not limited to, the following areas:
* Demonstrating extensive knowledge of hedging strategies and application of hedge accounting requirements under US GAAP/IFRS;
* Demonstrating significant experience valuing derivatives, including interest rate swaps, FX, options, forward contracts, swaps, etc.;
* financial instruments hedging, treasury and derivatives accounting, embedded derivatives;
* complex transactions in new and established products through an understanding of complex and/or new accounting and tax standards;
* Understanding business intelligence and performance management software tools; – Understanding software implementation phases, including unit testing, systems integration and user acceptance testing
* Being Proficient in utilizing technology and industry software for efficient financial analysis and reporting.
* Upholding the firm's code of ethics and business conduct.


**Must\-have**
* Experience with multi\-entity or global treasury implementations
* Knowledge of treasury regulations and compliance standards (SOX, KYC, etc.).
* Excellent problem\-solving, project management, and communication skills.
* Team player, committed to providing high quality work and maintaining timeliness
* Demonstrate self\-motivation and a desire to take responsibility for personal growth and development
* Commitment to continuous training and to proactively learn new processes Preferred


**Years Of Experience**
 Minimum 3 years experience certified in Core Kyriba Course (Cash Management Certification
   

  

**Good\-to\-have**
* Basic understanding of corporate financial statements and various types of securities/Financial Instruments
* Playing a role in discussions, proactively ask questions and share an informed point of view
* Strong understanding of TMS modules such as cash positioning, forecasting, in\-house banking, payments, and accounting integration.
* Experience in ERP integration (SAP, Oracle, etc.) and bank connectivity (SWIFT, API, H2H).


**Education Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Real Estate, Engineering (of any discipline), Geoinformatics, Business Administration, Information Technology
* B.COM, B.Tech, B.SC, BBA


**Credentials**

**Certifications**

title: Lead Application Engineer
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 Systems Engineering ist eine funktionsübergreifende technische Disziplin, die sich auf einen Ansatz, eine Denkweise und einen Prozess konzentriert. Alle Tätigkeiten, die sowohl die geschäftlichen als auch die technischen Anforderungen der Kunden berücksichtigen, mit dem Ziel, ein Qualitätsprodukt bereitzustellen, das die Anforderungen der Benutzer erfüllt. Die Disziplin zur Umsetzung eines soliden Prozesses zum Entwerfen, Erstellen und Optimieren von Systemen, der aus der Identifizierung und Quantifizierung von Systemanforderungen, der Erstellung alternativer Systementwurfskonzepte, der Durchführung von Design\-Trade\-off\-Studien, der Auswahl und Implementierung der besten Entwürfe und der Überprüfung der Tatsache besteht, dass das Design ordnungsgemäß integriert ist und ausgeführt wird. Prozess, der vom Konzept über die Produktion bis zum Betrieb verläuft.
   

  

 Verantwortlich für die Planung/Ausführung des Abteilungsbetriebs oder konzentriert sich auf die Ausführung von beruflichen Tätigkeiten innerhalb einer technischen Disziplin.Hat eine gewisse Autonomie, wird jedoch von festgelegten Richtlinien oder der Überprüfung der Endergebnisse geleitet.
   

  

 Die Stelle ermöglicht die Änderung von Arbeitsabläufen und Praktiken, sofern die Endergebnisse den Standards der Akzeptanz (Qualität, Umfang, Aktualität usw.) entsprechen.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten**
* Führt Komponenten\- und Produktintegration durch. Alle Aktivitäten, die mehrere Komponenten und Produkte umfassen und sich mit der Integration für maximale Leistung und Bedienbarkeit befassen. Verwaltet Produkt\- und Systemanforderungen, Spezifikationen und den Datenfluss. Führt Validierungs\- und Verifizierungsaktivitäten für das gesamte Produkt/System durch, einschließlich Tests auf Systemebene. Verantwortlich für die Definition der Produktanforderungen für das Modul/die Komponente/Subunternehmer und Partnerteams. Verwaltet die Schnittstelle zwischen Komponenten und Ausführungsorganisationen. Verantwortlich für das Vorantreiben von CTQ/Risk\-Trades innerhalb der Teams, die die Komponenten entwerfen. Verwaltet die Gesamtproduktkonfiguration und das Konfigurationssteuerungssystem.
* Nutzt vertiefte Kenntnisse einer technischen Disziplin sowie analytisches Denken und technische Erfahrung zur Umsetzung von Richtlinien/Strategien.
* Hat Kenntnisse über Best Practices und darüber, wie sich der eigene Bereich in andere integriert; ist sich des Wettbewerbs und der Faktoren bewusst, die das Unternehmen auf dem Markt auszeichnen
* Nutzt ein gewisses Urteilsvermögen und hat die Fähigkeit, verschiedene Lösungen außerhalb der festgelegten Parameter vorzuschlagen, um kompliziertere Herstellungsprozesse mit technischer Vielfalt und/oder voneinander abhängigen Produktionszyklen anzugehen.Verwendet technische Erfahrung und analytisches Denken.Verwendet mehrere interne und begrenzte externe Quellen außerhalb der eigenen Teams, um Entscheidungen zu treffen.
* Dient als Ressource für Kollegen mit weniger Erfahrung.Kann kleine Projekte mit geringen Risiken und Ressourcenanforderungen leiten.Erklärt Informationen; Entwicklung von Fähigkeiten, um Teammitglieder zu einem Konsens über Themen innerhalb des Feldes zu bewegen.Vermittelt Leistungserwartungen und kann vertrauliche Themen behandeln.


**Grundqualifikationen**
* Diese Rolle erfordert fortgeschrittene Erfahrung. Der Wissensstand ist vergleichbar mit einem Bachelor\-Abschluss einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule (oder einem Abitur mit relevanter Erfahrung).


**Gewünschte Eigenschaften**
* Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Ausgeprägte Sozialkompetenz und Führungsqualitäten. Fähigkeit, andere zu beeinflussen und kleine Teams zu führen. Initiativen von mittlerem Umfang und mittlerer Wirkung leiten. Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig zu koordinieren. Effektive Erkennung und Lösung von Problemen. Nachweisliche analytische und organisatorische Fähigkeiten.Hinweis:Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind.Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden.Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern.Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern.

 Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop and inspire others to deliver quality. **Skills**
 Examples of the skills, knowledge, and experiences you need to lead and deliver value at this level include but are not limited to:

description:
**About Bazaarvoice**
 At Bazaarvoice, we create smart shopping experiences. Through our expansive global network, product\-passionate community \& enterprise technology, we connect thousands of brands and retailers with billions of consumers. Our solutions enable brands to connect with consumers and collect valuable user\-generated content, at an unprecedented scale. This content achieves global reach by leveraging our extensive and ever\-expanding retail, social \& search syndication network. And we make it easy for brands \& retailers to gain valuable business insights from real\-time consumer feedback with intuitive tools and dashboards. The result is smarter shopping: loyal customers, increased sales, and improved products.
   

  

 The problem we are trying to solve : Brands and retailers struggle to make real connections with consumers. It's a challenge to deliver trustworthy and inspiring content in the moments that matter most during the discovery and purchase cycle. The result? Time and money spent on content that doesn't attract new consumers, convert them, or earn their long\-term loyalty.
   

  

 Our brand promise : closing the gap between brands and consumers.
   

  

 Founded in 2005, Bazaarvoice is headquartered in Austin, Texas with offices in North America, Europe, Asia and Australia.
   

  

 It’s official: Bazaarvoice is a Great Place to Work in the US , Australia, India, Lithuania, France, Germany and the UK!
   

  

**Job Description**
 At Bazaarvoice, we create smart shopping experiences. Our mission is to build smarter shopper experiences across the entire customer journey — from discovery on social to conversion on the product page. Whether it's optimizing a shoppable gallery experience on a retailer PDP or scaling visual content distribution across a global brand\-retailer network, we're here to be a true strategic partner for businesses.
   

  

 As the Senior Product Manager responsible for Bazaarvoice Social Galleries and Visual Syndication Network, you will play a critical role in shaping how brands and retailers display and distribute visual user\-generated content at scale. Your primary focus will be on understanding the needs of brand marketers, retailer merchandising teams, and end shoppers — then building products that drive trust, engagement, and conversion through authentic visual experiences at every point of sale.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Defining a strategy and creating a 1–2 year roadmap for Social Galleries and Visual Syndication Network, balancing the needs of both sides of Bazaarvoice's brand\-retailer network.
* Knowing the pulse of the market: social commerce trends, visual UGC consumption behavior, and the competitive landscape of shoppable gallery and content syndication solutions.
* Serve as a product advocate for brands and retailers in discussions with clients, articulating how visual content display and distribution drive measurable lift in conversion and engagement.
* Discover and validate problems — from gallery rendering performance and shoppability on PDPs to syndication match rate gaps across the retailer network — through research, data analysis, and experimentation.
* Lead Product Discovery and Early Adopter Programs to validate display and distribution features iteratively with high\-value brand and retailer clients.
* Partner with Marketing and Sales to define product positioning, competitive differentiation, and pricing strategy for visual UGC display and syndication capabilities.
* Make prioritization decisions that balance syndication infrastructure reliability with shopper\-facing experience improvements — gallery rendering, shoppability, personalization, and placement flexibility.
* Own the full product lifecycle — from build through market testing, GTM launch, success narrative, and iterative enhancement. Evangelize product releases with data\-driven narratives connecting visual syndication volume and gallery engagement metrics to client ROI.
* Work with Technical Services and Product Knowledge teams to build internal training and external documentation for gallery and syndication capabilities. Communicate across teams to ensure consistent backlog alignment and that engineering has everything needed to size, accept, and execute on work.


**Essential Criteria**
* 5\+ years of product management experience, ideally with exposure to content distribution networks, syndication platforms, or visual commerce display surfaces
* Strategic thinking with the ability to develop a roadmap that serves both brand and retailer stakeholders across a global visual syndication network
* Ability to prioritize across competing investments — syndication infrastructure reliability, retailer integration scalability, and shopper\-facing gallery experience improvements
* Understanding of content delivery, retailer API integrations, and the technical nuances of rendering visual assets at scale across heterogeneous retail environments
* Ability to define and track metrics like Syndication Match Rate, Visual Content Volume, Gallery Engagement Rate, and shoppability conversion lift
* Experience conducting market research, competitive analysis, and customer interviews in a B2B2C context
* Adaptable and comfortable with ambiguity — retailer integration requirements vary widely and visual commerce display standards continue to evolve
* Familiarity with front\-end display performance considerations (Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, responsive media) as they relate to gallery experience on retailer PDPs
